g.text: Frame every recommendation around outcomes clients already track:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: COST

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Inefficient AI shows up on the cloud bill. A model right-sizing analysis reducing API spend by 60% is easy to approve.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Carbon benefit follows automatically.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: REPUTATION & PROCUREMENT

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Enterprise RFPs need environmental disclosures.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Financial services, public sector, large enterprise clients need to document their footprint.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Having a methodology matters more than having a low number.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: RISK

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Overclaiming 'carbon-neutral AI' without methodology backfires.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Greenwashing allegations are a reputational risk.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Honest framing: here is what we know, here is what we cannot measure, here is the plan to improve.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. MODEL RIGHT-SIZING (lowest effort)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Route to smallest model meeting quality.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Evaluate model tiers on actual query distribution.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Claude Haiku ≈ 20× cheaper per token than Opus.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Present as: smaller default + larger escalation + quality gate.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. CACHING

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Exact-match: identical prompts (cheap to implement).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Semantic: embedding similarity for near-duplicates.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 20-40% hit rate achievable in support/FAQ scenarios.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. PROMPT EFFICIENCY

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Audit system prompts for redundancy.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Compress retrieved context before injection.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Trim conversation history to relevant window.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3,000 → 1,200 tokens = 60% reduction in that component.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. REGIONAL ROUTING

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Norway hydro vs coal-heavy grid: up to 10× carbon difference.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Best for batch processing, training, evaluation jobs.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Latency limits this for user-facing inference.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. BATCHING

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Queue non-real-time jobs: document processing, nightly analysis.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: More compute-efficient than per-request calls.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. RETRIEVAL OVER RE-PROMPTING

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: RAG instead of packing full docs into context.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Embedding + retrieval cost << LLM tokens saved.

g.text: Discovery Questions — pick what fits the engagement:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. CARBON EFFICIENCY

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Reduce carbon intensity of the work.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: AI angle: smallest model that meets quality is always right.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Q: 'What is the minimum model for this task?' (not 'what is the best?')

text.font-family: Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: The sustainability conversation fixates on training. Wrong.

text.font-family: Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: For deployed systems, INFERENCE is where the footprint lives.

text.font-family: Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: SCI = ( O + M ) / R

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • What is the unit of value — one resolved ticket, one report, one session?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Where do repeated identical calls happen? (→ caching candidates)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Can a smaller model, rules engine, or human-in-loop handle part of the workflow?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • What regions and retention policies apply to your data and models?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Is there a batch window where latency requirements are relaxed?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: SCI 5-step process in practice:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Bound — which components count? (API calls, embeddings, storage, CI/CD)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Scale — choose R and keep it consistent

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. Define — document assumptions, choose telemetry or models per component

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. Quantify — compute rate per R for each component, sum them

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. Report — share score, boundary, methodology so others can verify

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Training = one-time cost. Inference = continuous.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1M queries/day = 365M inference calls/year.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: High-traffic production systems:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Inference dominates — often 80-90% of lifetime compute.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Research & experimentation:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Training and evaluation dominate.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Fine-tuning pipelines:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: One-time fine-tuning; inference dominates after deploy.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: R — Functional unit (unit of useful work)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: One API call / one user session / one report generated.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Everything expressed per R for consistent tracking.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: O — Operational emissions

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Carbon from electricity used for one R.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: O = E × I (energy in kWh × grid carbon intensity gCO₂eq/kWh)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: M — Embodied emissions

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Manufacturing + disposal share allocated to your workload.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Calculated from device lifecycle footprint × time reserved × resource share.

text.font-family: Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. ENERGY EFFICIENCY

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Same job with less electricity.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: GREENWASHING

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Do not say 'carbon neutral' without a verified methodology.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 'We use a cloud provider that claims renewable energy' is NOT a methodology.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: FALSE PRECISION

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: You will almost never have per-request energy data.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 'Based on token counts and model pricing as a compute proxy,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: we estimate this is in range X — actual could be 2-3× higher or lower' = honest and useful.

Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: They may have a role in a broader strategy, not as a replacement

g.text: for reducing the system's actual behaviour.

g.text: Resources: electricitymaps.com (grid carbon intensity) | sci.greensoftware.foundation | LFC131 (free GSF practitioner course)

text.font-family: Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: What LOWERS SCI:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: LLM API calls — largest per-unit; dominated by input token count

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Embedding & retrieval — moderate; runs on every query

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Storage & networking — smaller per call, but continuous

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Caching eliminates LLM calls for repeated queries.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 30% hit rate → 30% of LLM calls removed at near-zero cost.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. HARDWARE EFFICIENCY

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Utilize hardware well. Avoid stranded GPUs.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: AI angle: autoscaling, off-hours dev environments,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: instance types matched to workload. Stop training at diminishing returns.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Energy efficiency (less E) — fewer tokens, smaller models, caching

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Hardware efficiency (smaller M) — autoscaling, right-sizing

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Carbon awareness (lower I) — cleaner grid, time-shift to low-carbon hours

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Evaluation carbon cost:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Running 400-example eval once = responsible engineering.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Running 5,000-example eval every prompt tweak = waste.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Apply statistical power thinking: minimum N that reliably detects a meaningful

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: improvement — stop there.

text.font-family: Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Carbon offsets, RECs, PPAs do NOT reduce SCI.

text.font-family: Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: A vendor buying offsets ≠ reduced system footprint.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. MEASUREMENT

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: You improve what you measure.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: AI angle: token count, API calls per session, latency, dollar cost

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: are already monitored — they double as sustainability metrics.
